command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .bos/project.yaml && sed -n '1,260p' .github/workflows/burrito-release.yml && sed -n '1,220p' elixir/Makefile && sed -n '1,220p' elixir/mix.exs && git branch -a --format='%(refname:short) %(objectname)' && git remote -v"
outputSummary:
schemaVersion: 1
projectId: bos
repositoryId: symphony
workflowId: bos-autonomous-delivery
remote: https://github.com/acancelas/symphony
delivery:
  issueProvider: github
  issueRequired: true
  branchStrategy: issue-based
quality:
  commands:
    - id: test
      runner: shell
      script: cd elixir && mise exec -- mix test
      required: true
      timeoutSeconds: 900
environments:
  production:
    branch: main
    automaticDeployment: false
    requiresApproval: true
    requiresVerification: true
offline:
  allowed: [read, edit, local_checks]
  blocked: [push, pull_request, deployment]
name: burrito-release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: build-${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target: [linux_x86_64, linux_arm64, macos_x86_64, macos_arm64]
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: elixir

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Set up mise tools
        uses: jdx/mise-action@5228313ee0372e111a38da051671ca30fc5a96db # v3
        with:
          install: true
          cache: true
          working_directory: elixir

      - name: Install Zig
        run: mise install zig@0.15.2

      - name: Install xz
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y xz-utils

      - name: Install Mix dependencies
        run: |
          mix local.hex --force
          mix local.rebar --force
          mix deps.get

      - name: Verify release tag matches project version
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          project_version="$(sed -nE 's/^[[:space:]]*version: "([^"]+)",$/\1/p' mix.exs | head -n 1)"
          expected_tag="v$project_version"

          if test -z "$project_version" || test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" != "$expected_tag"; then
            echo "Release tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME do
